faqs.q: What is the difference between the balm and the crème?
faqs.a: The balm is a snowy-white, menthol-rich salve with a stronger warming-cooling action for deep joint and muscle pain. The crème uses the same proprietary formula in a lighter, non-greasy base that absorbs quickly and does not stain clothing.

faqs.q: How long can I wear the Pain Relief Patch?
faqs.a: Apply to clean, dry skin and remove after 6 hours. Use 2 to 3 patches a day at most, and do not apply to open wounds or during pregnancy or breastfeeding.
Yes. The balm, crème, liniment and Medi-Stick are made in Singapore under GMP. The patch is manufactured in Taiwan exclusively for HST Medical.
External use only. Do not use on broken skin, on children under two, or during pregnancy or breastfeeding without asking a pharmacist. Stop and seek advice if irritation occurs.

faqs.q: Which product should I take for a sore throat?
faqs.a: Start with Alievaid Herbal Drops or Ivy Leaf Drops. Both are lozenges you dissolve slowly, with loquat leaf, jie geng and luo han guo (Alievaid) or ivy leaf extract (Ivy Leaf) to soothe the throat and calm an irritating cough.

faqs.q: Is Flu Gard suitable for children?
faqs.a: Flu Gard is a traditional Chinese medicine formula in vegicaps for adults. Follow the label and ask a pharmacist for children, during pregnancy, or if symptoms last more than a few days.
Alievaid Herbal Drops carry Halal (Malaysia) certification. The certification mark is printed on each pack; the full list of certified products is being confirmed with HST Medical.

faqs.q: Can I use Sinus Clear more than once?
faqs.a: Yes. The bottom half is a refill: a few drops onto the inhaler's cotton stick restores it. Single-person use is recommended.

facts.delivery: Singapore delivery is free on orders above S$30.00, and S$1.99 for orders of S$30.00 and below. We cannot deliver to P.O. boxes or restricted areas such as Changi Airport, army camps, checkpoints, Jurong Island and the outlying islands.
facts.where: Besides this online store, HST Medical products are sold at Guardian, Watsons and NHGP pharmacies (including Changi Airport and Jewel), at Essentials Pharmacy in People's Park Centre, and online at FairPrice, Guardian, Watsons and NHGP.
facts.trade: Pharmacies, clinics, TCM halls and distributors can open a trade account. Email resellercontact@hstmedical.com or use the trade enquiry form, and a territory manager will reply within two working days.
facts.quality: HST Medical products are made under GMP (Good Manufacturing Practice). Halal-certified and vegan options are available; Alievaid Herbal Drops carry Halal (Malaysia) certification.
facts.about: HST Medical (博诚药业) is a Singapore health supplements and pain relief company. It began with Heng Say Tong, a family medical hall founded in 1930, and was incorporated as HST Medical Pte Ltd in 1994. Since 29 May 2026 it has been part of Kowa Pharmaceutical Asia, in Japan's Kowa group. Its brands are Rheuma-Salve®, Heritage®, HST Medical® and Zoo-Vite®. HST stands for Higher, Stronger, Together.
facts.payment: Payment is taken on the secure checkout page after you enter your delivery details. The payment options shown there (for example cards or PayNow) depend on the payment provider set up for the store. Card details are never typed into this chat.
facts.overseas: Yes, we ship overseas. Express shipping reaches most countries in 3 to 7 working days; standard shipping goes to selected countries, including Malaysia, the Philippines and Vietnam, in up to 21 working days. Import duties and taxes are paid by the buyer, and some countries limit health supplements. Rheuma-Salve products cannot be shipped to Malaysia, and Middle East deliveries are suspended for now.
facts.gst: All prices are in Singapore dollars and include GST at 9%.
facts.returns: For order problems, a damaged parcel or a wrong item, email order@hstmedical.com with your order number. Overseas parcels refused at customs (unpaid duties or missing import licences) cannot be refunded.
